function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Using only evidence available through the benchmark tools, reconstruct the Internet Research Agency's social-media influence operation during 2016. Locate and synthesize all relevant source IDs and the exact evidence from: United States Department of Justice indictment facts; United States Senate findings; platform-generated data or disclosures; identified personas, pages, groups, handles, and accounts; funding, payment, ownership, employment, and organizational relationships; campaign objectives, audiences, tactics, events, and timelines. For every proposition, classify whether it is a verified fact, an allegation, an assessment, or uncertain/inferred, and preserve the source's own level of confidence. Identify supported entities, events, relationships, temporal bounds, tactics, audiences, and objectives; test for consistency and explicitly record contradictions or unresolved gaps. Do not use outside knowledge, do not invent source IDs, and do not infer unsupported relationship types. Return a structured research dossier suitable for a final Markdown report followed by JSON arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Include source IDs exactly as returned by the benchmark tools and quote or closely summarize the supporting evidence."}
function.name: ConductResearch
